items.title: K3 Hodge structures transported through the Debarre-Voisin projection and jump cascade to congruences of lines and the Peskine variety
items.difficulty_reason: H2: standard projective-bundle or blow-up formulas alone do not produce the required correspondences or identify the K3 summands on the auxiliary varieties. The authors resolve rational Grassmannian projections, determine exact exceptional loci, codimensions and jumping projective fibers, supply the integral Hodge/Gysin splitting for the resulting proper maps, and combine the two projection stages with the (2,3) and (1,2) flag jumps. Tracking the minimal Hodge structure, purity of the ambient and exceptional loci, the three distinct degrees on T and P and the final very-general vanishing-cohomology identification is the nonroutine geometric-Hodge core. The supplied original construction and Appendix48 proof are retained together, not reduced to dimension numerology or a categorical conjecture.

editorial_notes: Count exact original Theorem21/keyK and full Hodge correspondence core once. Intro unnumbered three-copy statement is a restatement; projective/flag formulas and Appendix48 are supporting core, not extra IDs.
Use original smooth/general choices in the cascade. The final projection center is the kernel of the two-form defining I(3,9), not an arbitrary center.

Preserve K as the original minimal indecomposable sub-Hodge structure containing H9,11(Y), author Tate twists and integral-Hodge wording. Very general is required for the final vanishing-cohomology identification only.

Retain Y1 in degree14, Y2 in8, T in6/8/10 and P in4/6/8. The theorem identifies vanishing cohomology for Y1,Y2 and T only in degrees6/10; it does not identify all primitive cohomology of P or T degree8 with K.
Conjectures19/23/28 and the P primitive-cohomology discussion remain open original context. No categorical three-Kuznetsov-component equivalence or Torelli is promoted to the Hodge theorem.
The categorical/Coble/Appendix49 branches remain separate ongoing intake; this batch does not declare the entire55-position work finished.

standard_prerequisites.name: Debarre-Voisin and Kuznetsov cited inputs
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original source cites Debarre-Voisin for vanishing Hodge dimensions1,20,1 and very-general simplicity, and Kuznetsov for the108-object/K3-category background. These cited results are inputs; the selected new conclusion is Hodge transport, not a fresh proof of those prior results or categorical equivalence.

core_obligations: Y=T(3,10) is a smooth general Debarre-Voisin hyperplane and the diagram uses smooth associated Y1=IH(3,9),Y2=IH2(3,8),T=T(2,10),P=P(1,10), with exact exceptional centers Z=I(2,9),Z1=I2(2,8).
Keep the kernel-center choice for the last projection and the smoothness restrictions used in the general projection and jump formulas.
K is the author minimal indecomposable sub-Hodge structure containing H9,11(Y); preserve all Tate conventions without independent certification.
Exact Theorem21 transports K to degree14 ofY1, degree8 ofY2, degrees6/8/10 ofT and4/6/8 ofP; off-diagonal quotient vanishes as stated.
For very generalY, equality with vanishing cohomology is claimed only forY1,Y2 andT degrees6/10; no P primitive or T degree8 equality is added.
All geometric resolution, integral Hodge decomposition, exceptional-locus purity, degree comparison and very-general simplicity inputs stay attached.
Hodge conclusions do not establish categorical Conjecture23/28, rationality obstructions or period-map isomorphisms.
